description: WHEN: to READ from ONE Dynamics 365 F&O instance, as the signed-in user (their own F&O roles and legal entities apply): look up entities, query data, open a form to read it. Same arguments as erp_call, but it refuses every tool that could change data, on every instance, so it never needs the user's approval. Get the tool name and argument schema from erp_list_tools first. Use erp_call only for a change the user asked for.

arguments.description: JSON object with the tool arguments, as a string. Omit or "{}" when none.

name: erp_read
